entries.candidate: Vantage Data Centers 'Project Latigo' PUD (portions of Sections 1, 2, 3 and 11, T12N R67W and Section 35, T13N R67W, 6th P.M., Laramie County, Wyoming; west of the Project Tembo sections)
entries.reason: Laramie County's Legistar web API records Planning Commission file 26-426 ('Review and Recommendation on a Zone Change from Land Use (LU) to Planned Unit Development (PUD) zone district for Project Latigo', recommended for approval 3-0 on 13 August 2026 with the condition that agency comments be addressed before a site-plan application) and Board of County Commissioners file 26-451 (public hearing on the same zone change, approved on 1 September 2026 with no conditions); both records carry 'Vantage Data Centers' in the field that holds the applicant or owner in the county's other land-use files, with Palma Land Planning, LLC as agent (local legistar-laramie-18985*.json, legistar-laramie-19010*.json). Not admitted: (1) no captured public text says the PUD is for a data center; the county's public LegislationDetail page omits the applicant field, the staff reports and packets sit on laramiecounty.legistar1.com (robots.txt disallows all paths) and the Internet Archive holds no copy of either attachment, and Vantage's news and data-center sitemaps (retrieved 26 October 2026) have no Wyoming item; (2) the only locator is the BLM CadNSDI union of the five named sections (3,222 acres, a cross centred on Section 2 at 41.0372465 N, 104.8580948 W, local blm-plss-wy-latigo-sections.json), about 2.6 km from its furthest corner, because the Laramie County parcel viewer (Beacon) answered HTTP 403; (3) a rezoning is not consent for the works (a site plan must follow), so only announced would be supported. The union touches the Project Tembo Sections 5 and 7, T12N R66W at one corner (centroids 4.1 km apart); the Atlas's Crusoe and Tallgrass (Project Jade) record keeps an inherited point 28 km north and the Latigo applicant differs from Tembo's.
entries.reopen_condition: A captured public record (county staff report, minutes, published proceedings, Vantage release, utility or DEQ filing) that describes Project Latigo as a Vantage data-center campus, and a parcel-level or site-plan locator (county parcels for the PUD, a recorded plat, or a filing coordinate); a site-plan approval within 85 days would support permitted.
